findings.summary: The new __next__ override on _NamedTextIOWrapper converts StopIteration into EOFError, so iterating sys.stdin or click.get_text_stream('stdin') under CliRunner raises EOFError instead of ending the loop; the conversion belongs in visible_input/hidden_input.
Replacing readline() with next(text_input) makes prompts with empty or short input raise EOFError and abort the run instead of receiving an empty string, breaking existing user tests.
The edited assertion removes the `assert not result.exception` check and slices output with [:-2], so the test passes even when the pipeline aborts from the new EOFError, hiding the regression.
